description.value:
This hard-shelled briefcase can hold up to 1 Bulk of documents and equipment. You can install shields and weapons into your assault briefcase, but they must be the same grade or lower than the briefcase.

You can Install a one-handed ranged weapon of 1 Bulk or less into the assault briefcase. You gain a +2 item bonus to Stealth checks and DCs to Conceal a Weapon installed in the assault briefcase (+4 if the weapon has the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Concealed] trait). You can deploy the installed weapon with an Interact action, allowing you to wield it in one hand while holding the briefcase.

You can Install a deflecting field into the assault briefcase and use it as though it were armor. If you use a weapon integrated into the briefcase for any purpose while the shield is raised, the shield is no longer raised, and you no longer receive a bonus to your AC.
